tool_schemas.name: search_catalog

tool_schemas.name: place_order
tool_schemas.description: Place a purchase order with the primary supplier (charges the budget).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded only when a request completes. A request that failed partway is not recorded: part of it may have taken effect, and repeating it with the same key runs it again. After a failure or timeout, check current state before retrying.

tool_schemas.name: place_order_vendor_b
tool_schemas.description: Place the same purchase order via the secondary supplier.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded only when a request completes. tool_schemas.name: cancel_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancel a purchase order and refund it.
